_note: Owner-controlled accessibility presentation. Browser preferences remain in localStorage. Built into menu.js from this file; missing/invalid values use safe defaults.

palettes._note: Positive, negative and neutral semantic colours; all hex values are six-digit.

appearance._note: Soft semantic backgrounds, solid fill text, and monochrome fills.

contrast._note: WCAG-inspired minimum ratio for text/fills; comparison backgrounds and advisory distinguishability threshold.

defaults._note: Browser-local preference defaults; user may override on their device.

labels._note: Settings UI labels and advisory warning text.
labels.low_light: Selected colours may be difficult to read on light backgrounds.
labels.low_dark: Selected colours may be difficult to read on dark backgrounds.
labels.low_fill: White text on solid fills may be difficult to read.
labels.similar: Positive and negative colours may be difficult to distinguish; automatic contrast correction cannot guarantee distinguishability.
